questions.text: What is the minimum number of partners in an OG?
options: Three
Two
Seven
One
Personally without limit, directly, jointly and severally
Only with company assets and never personally
Only up to the registered liability amount
Limited to their own capital contribution
questions.correctAnswer: Personally without limit, directly, jointly and severally

questions.text: Who may generally manage and represent an OG?
options: Only an appointed managing director
Only the partner with the largest capital share
Only a supervisory board
Each partner individually

questions.text: Who has unlimited liability in a KG?
options: The silent partner
The limited partner (Kommanditist)
The general partner
Both only up to the liability amount

questions.text: In the Hobel & Leim OG case, who decides to hire a bookkeeper?
options: Hobel alone, because he runs the workshop.
Leim, because he is responsible for the commercial side.
The bank, because it is a creditor.
Only the commercial register court.
questions.correctAnswer: Leim, because he is responsible for the commercial side.

questions.text: Which statement about a silent partnership is correct?
options: It is a contractual stake and is not entered in the commercial register
The silent partner is listed as a partner in the register
It is a separate legal form with its own legal personality
The silent partner must manage the business alone
questions.correctAnswer: It is a contractual stake and is not entered in the commercial register

questions.text: An OG partner signs a contract despite an internal rule that only another partner may sign. What applies externally?
options: The contract binds only the signing partner
The contract is automatically void
The contract is valid only after supervisory-board approval
The contract is generally valid externally
questions.correctAnswer: The contract is generally valid externally

questions.text: An OG and a KG pay income tax themselves on their profits.
A minimum net turnover is required to establish a legal form.
An OG has failed to repay a EUR 70,000 loan. What may the bank demand from one individual OG partner?
questions.correctAnswer: The bank may demand the full EUR 70,000 from one partner; liability is personal, unlimited, direct, joint and several.
